regression.before: Authority was checked before BEGIN IMMEDIATE only. A competing SQLite writer could hold that call while the grant was revoked, after which create/edit/delete writes were committed and replay was acknowledged.
regression.baseline_observed: The four negative cases failed on unchanged base: create/edit/delete returned admitted and replay returned duplicate after revocation. The independent observer sees forbidden durable changes for the three non-replay cases.
regression.fix: Revalidate the full grant after the local SQLite write lock is acquired, before any admission read/write or duplicate acknowledgment. Require exactly the same validated Grant.
regression.scope: No wire shape, schema, retry/dispatch authority, provider access or runtime activation added.

passed.mutation: Removing the post-lock recheck causes all four negative regression cases to fail; independently read durable state changes in create/edit/delete cases.
passed.optimized_children: Fresh-process and mutation children inherit -O; behavioral oracles use unittest assertions.

real_boundaries: Existing actual SQLite database schema and transaction machinery
Fresh Python process blocked behind an independently held write transaction
Independent full SQLite dumps and row counts
fake_boundaries: Synthetic grant resolver controlled by a disposable local file
Invented actor, task, host, destination, event, and text
Synthetic transport authentication in fixtures; no live account or Core authorization service
commands: ruff check --select E4,E7,E9,F,I tether/admission.py tests/test_admission_authority.py tests/test_slack_ingress.py
protected_scope: STATUS, schemas, workflows, image gates, pins, static baselines, provenance and existing historical evidence receipts are byte-preserved. No provider, native, runtime, infrastructure, credential, security setting, installation or deployment change.
limits: The resolver is trusted, bounded, side-effect-free and non-reentrant. Its post-lock call must not perform provider/network work or wait on this database.
The local recheck does not make revocation after that check atomic with a remote authority service or dispatch; Core still requires its authoritative admission/dispatch gate.
No automatic retry or production compatibility qualification is introduced.
Existing signed-ingress evidence remains a historical record of its original revision.
